Subject:

M-B111126-01 Upcoming training courses

NOTICE DATE: 
November 11, 2026

NOTICE TYPE: 
M-B111126-01 Education/Training

SHORT DESCRIPTION: 
Upcoming training courses

INTENDED AUDIENCE: 
ERCOT Market Participants

DAY AFFECTED: 
See course schedule below.

LONG DESCRIPTION: 
ERCOT invites you to take advantage of its market training program that includes a wide variety of courses ranging from general introductions to deeper explorations of specific market topics and processes. 

Note that the following courses have been renamed:

"Forward Markets 101" is now "Hedging 101"

"Settlement: Congestion Revenue Rights" is now "Congestion Revenue Rights Settlements"

"Settlement: Ancillary Services" is now "Ancillary Service Settlement"

"Load Serving Entity 201" is now "Hedging for Load Serving Entities"

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: 
To enroll in a course, go to the ERCOT Training website at 
http://www.ercot.com/services/training/
. Select the course you are interested in attending. On the "Schedule/Registration" tab, select the "Sign up" link to register for the course. These courses are part of a series of instructor-led and web-based training courses available to Market Participants. To view the complete catalog of ERCOT market and operational courses, select 
Course Catalog
 from the ERCOT Training website.

CONTACT: 
If you have any questions, please contact ERCOT Training via email at 
Training@ercot.com
. You may also call the general ERCOT Client Services phone number at (512) 248-3900 or contact ERCOT Client Services via email at 
ClientServices@ercot.com
.

If you are receiving email from a public ERCOT distribution list that you no longer wish to receive, please follow this link in order to unsubscribe from this list: 
http://lists.ercot.com
